# IsolatedColorTree

## Summary

The isolated format of the `ColorTree` card — the app itself. Renders the Munsell color solid as an interactive WebGL specimen: tumble it, slice it open by hue leaf or value plane, open the atlas (the same voxels laid flat as a page), morph between Munsell's measured tree and Itten's idealized sphere, and pick colors straight off the canvas. Picks are saved (debounced) to the card's `selectedColor` and `selectedMunsell` fields. Optional sine-voice audio feedback and device-orientation (gyro) control on touch devices. All WebGL work is delegated to `TreeEngine` in `utils/tree-engine`.

## Import

```javascript
import { IsolatedColorTree } from '../components/color-tree-isolated';
```

## Usage

Wired as the card's isolated format:

```gts
export class ColorTree extends CardDef {
  static isolated = IsolatedColorTree;
}
```

Rendered when the card is opened full-size:

```hbs
<@fields.colorTree @format='isolated' />
```
